ordinary_ram_snapshots.ordering: Raw snapshots are stored before masked pending is written back to the local stack and dispatched. These RAM words are not the live hardware registers.
ordinary_ram_snapshots.reference_windows: Eighteen selected page-base candidates, two 16-instruction matching windows; both identify the selected event-loop stores. Aliases and ROM writers may be missed.

work_init_wrapper_and_event_loop.limitation: No matched reference to the event-loop entry does not prove it is uncalled; computed, aliased and ROM paths are not covered.

next_measurement_proposal.protocol: Retarget, do not expand, the established four-query ordinary-RAM sampler at 100/300 ms during one 500 ms passive channel-40 scan. Complete source/wire/classifier, build, candidate, guarded deployment and changed-boot gates before any execution.
branches: Cached enable bit clear: investigate selected receive initialization and mask ownership; not proof that live hardware is disabled.
Cached enable set and pending clear: prioritize pending/descriptor production and RF receive enabling; not proof of absence throughout scan.
Cached native pending seen: prioritize dispatch/descriptor lookup and scheduling, with snapshot timing and freshness limitations.
Missing, late or post-DONE observations: no before-DONE conclusion.

limitations: Mode-4 containing state graph hit its node budget; only inspected local paths are used and no complete-writer claim follows.
ROM callbacks and computed/aliased callers remain unresolved; no function pointer, mask, filter or firmware RAM write is justified.
Cached words may be stale and are non-atomic when queried; they cannot prove continuous IRQ availability, RF listening or packet counts.
Firmware logical register addresses are not AP physical addresses and are not admitted live read/write targets.
sanitization: Private firmware, disassembly and binary inputs omitted; independent source summaries, addresses, bounded counts and hashes only.
